floor_history.headline: func_80030580 s1 recon: clean pure-C rewrite 45->2; body byte-identical, only the 24-byte phantom frame (ours 8) remains; mechanism = combine.c REG_DEAD-orphan USE slots

Floor flat at 2; the 16 missing frame bytes are now TYPED - a corpus census proves the target's vars=24 is three 8-byte combine-orphan spill slots, not a BLKmode temp, and 44 structural respellings al

frontier.hypothesis: The second Judge lookup's folded symbol pseudo (reg 130) can be pushed onto the same combine path as the first (reg 110), yielding a second 8-byte orphan slot
frontier.mechanism: combine.c:10761 - distribute_notes breaks out early when the dying register is elim_i2/elim_i1 (the register the i2->i3 fold eliminated), dropping the REG_DEAD note before it can reach the label-walk at combine.c:10836 that emits the orphan USE
frontier.next_probe: add a BB2_COMBINE_DEBUG print inside distribute_notes in tools/gcc-2.7.2/combine.c logging (note reg, from_insn, i1, i2, i3, elim_i1, elim_i2, chosen place), rebuild the instrumented cc1, run it on draft3 and on display.c's get_cs, and diff the paths taken by reg 110 vs reg 130 and by get_cs's two orphans; then hunt a body-neutral spelling that routes the second lookup through the first's path

frontier.hypothesis: A third orphan slot is reachable from a pseudo class not yet observed in this function
frontier.mechanism: reload1 alter_reg gives a slot to any pseudo left with no register class; combine orphan USEs are one source, but the corpus may contain others (the instrumented cc1 emits a distinct ctx= label per allocation site)
frontier.next_probe: grep BB2_FRAME_DEBUG in tools/gcc-2.7.2/ to enumerate every ctx= label cc1 can emit, then re-run census2.py over all src/*.c filtering for leaves (args=0, regs=0, 0 sp accesses) with vars=24 and read their C for where the third slot comes from

frontier.hypothesis: One global folded at two sites can orphan twice, so Judge alone can supply two of the three slots
frontier.mechanism: each folded symbol_ref pseudo is a separate pseudo (reg 107 and reg 127 pre-combine), so two independent deaths are possible in principle
frontier.next_probe: census the two-slot leaves (config:func_8003FECC, main:SpuSetCommonAttr) for whether their two slots come from two distinct globals or from one global read twice; if one-global-twice is witnessed anywhere, port that call-site spelling into draft3 and measure vars=
